doc: slope 0 and low 0: the amplitude is 1 for every mode INCLUDING the DC mode (radius 0 passes `kk >= 0`, and max(0, 1e-9)^-0 = 1), so the field is the white noise itself, normalized: (white - mean) / std. Well-conditioned way to hit the max(kk, 1e-9) guard. The white noise the seed draws is the input plan0.white (size, size). FFT convention: numpy fft2 unnormalized forward, ifft2 divides by size^2, k = fftfreq(size) * size. Measured: every random input nudged by one float64 ulp (8 trials) and numpy.fft replaced by scipy.fft: max |diff| 1.8e-15 (6e-13 relative on values above 1e-3), so 1e-9 relative / 1e-10 absolute.
